text: Operator cannot complete fan checkout in chat. For buy/purchase seat asks: use publish_event + inventory_zones on apex-dev, then search_orders to verify sale. Never invent order ids, seat numbers, or payment results.
Show/list/search customers or fans: search_customers — POST /search/v1/customers (axs-apex-search Customers, permission b2b_search_customers).
Search fan orders by email or order number: search_orders — POST /search/v1/orders (axs-apex-search Orders).
Find events by name: search_events — POST /search/v1/events/suggest or /v1/events (axs-apex-search).
List or browse events catalog / upcoming on home: marketing_events — marketing-api GET /v1/events (axs-apex-marketing, axs-apex-home upcoming list).

Inventory zones, price levels, sections, ticket types, best available on an event: inventory_zones — inventory-api for event UUID (axs-apex-inventory). Best available for a named customer requires search_customers first, then inventory on a chosen event.
Publish event to on sale: publish_event — events-api (axs-apex-events). Prerequisite before fan purchase.
Client venues and organizations: list_client_venues, create_organization, create_client_venue — admin-api (axs-apex-admin).
B2B user directory: list_users — resources-api (axs-apex-admin accounts area).
